contexts.text: If the Lord did not protect man every moment, he would perish...
I have been so protected by the Lord. AC 1271.
Nothing can hurt those whom the Lord protects, even if they should be encompassed by all Hell both without and within...
Protection against evils and falsities. Signified, Explained.
That the Lord protects those who are in the good of charity. Signified.
Those in innocence are the safest of all. Signified.
All in Heaven are kept safe by the Lord through states of innocence. This protection sig.
The terror of God = protection. Explained.
As, with such, there is in the internal man no receptacle of good and truth, they cannot be protected by the Angels.
When they apperceive that he is interiorly protected by the Angels, the evil Spirits excite the falsities he had thought, and the evils he had done...
Thus do the Angels elevate the man's mind from falsities, and protect it from evils.
The Angels through whom the Lord... protects man, are near the head. Described.
Sometimes the Angels exercise their power by protecting man against many Hells...
To couch = to lie down in safety.
Those in celestial good are safe through good.
That he is safe among all in the Hells. Signified.
That he is safe by the combating truth of doctrine. Signified, Explained.
One who was in natural truth, and was safe in many Hells.

When man is being reformed... as to the external man he is let into his evils and falsities, consequently among infernal Spirits who... fly around him, and try in every way to destroy him; but the good and truth which inflow through the internal man render him safe... for that which acts interiorly prevails immensely over that which acts exteriorly. Explained.
Prudence as to whether he was in safety. Signified.
That he was not yet in truths, so as to be safe. Signified, Explained... For those in truths are safe wherever they go, even in the midst of the Hells.
For the Lord protects those in infestation and temptation.
For the sake of protecting themselves, the human race congregated into kingdoms...
The conducting of the Spiritual Church through the midst of Hell, and their protection then by the Lord. Treated of. AC 8194. AC 8236.
When the Divine is present with the good, and protects them against the evil, the evil burn still more against them...
That the Lord protects against all the evils and falsities which are from the Hells. Signified, Explained.
The continual war and protection of the Lord against those who are in the falsity of interior evil. Signified.
The brazen serpent represented protection.
That the zeal from mercy of the Lord when He protects His own against the evil, appears as hostility and anger. Explained. AC 8875:3. AC 9313:end. LJCont 28.
The reason evil is not to be resisted, is that evil hurts not those who are in truth and good; for they are safe by the Lord.
The Spirits of Saturn feared nothing, because they were safe.
Truths of doctrine from the Word, through which there is protection from the falsities of evil. Signified.
The Hells continually endeavour to infest... but the Lord continually protects...
When the Lord has protected against the evils and falsities which infest the Church. Signified.
By the mere protection of Heaven by the Lord, Hell is removed; that is, by the mere protection of those who are in good and truth, those in evil and falsity are removed.
Protection from falsifications of truth and adulterations of good. Signified.
The good proceeding from the Lord... protects them. Signified.
The manner in which this ultimate proceeds from good, so as to render Heaven safe. Signified, Explained.
Thus strong and safe from injury. Signified.
To be in safety from infestation... because in the Lord through love. Signified.
Protection from the Hells. Signified, Explained.
This is why those in Heaven are in safety from infestation...

Those who are solely in truths (can have no protection in the other life; because truth can be approached by the evil, for the reason that the evil pervert truths by wrong interpretations... But in proportion as there is good in the truths, in the same proportion truths cannot be approached).
The Lord's safeguard lest man should enter into the things of Heaven or the Church from his Sensuous. Representation.

The infernal crew... inflict penalties on everyone who is not protected by the Lord; and therefore when one does evil from an evil heart, as this rejects from itself all protection by the Lord, they rush on him...

Unless the Lord protected man, he could never be rescued from Hell... and the Lord cannot protect man, unless he acknowledges the Divine, and lives a life of faith and charity; for otherwise he averts himself from the Lord, and turns himself to the infernal Spirits...
The Lord continually protects the Heavens by withholding those who are there from the evils of their proprium...
(The protection of evil Spirits by the simple good.)
Acknowledged them as their guardian Angels.
A sign representative of the protection of the Angels by the Lord.
Uses for the sustentation of the body relate to its protection, etc. DLW 333.
A good man is solely in the prudence and zeal of protecting... (So) the Angels [merely] protect themselves. (Thus) it is allowable for everyone to defend his country...
Their protection by the Lord. Signified. AR 545. AE 641. AE 728.
The tutelary God of that city.
A sphere of protection of good and truth against evil and falsity (proceeds from the Lord). CL 386.
That the sphere of the love of infants is a sphere of the protection and sustentation of those who cannot protect and sustain themselves. Explained.
We have been guardians of a Trinity of Persons...
Unless man acknowledges... His protection against Hell...
The third commandment = ... peace, because protection from Hell.
The honouring of guardians by their wards.
When Spirits harass them, they say they are safe; because they know that the Lord protects them.
Therefore he who is in order... cannot suffer violence from the evil, because the Lord protects him.
On guardian Angels...
So that if the Lord did not protect me, I should perish at any moment.
Thus he is safe who in the Truth of faith believes himself nothing.
If not protected by the Lord...
The sphere of the Lord's Divine around those whom the Lord protects...
The Lord protects His own by Divine truth; for He surrounds them with a sphere of light...
Those now in truths and in the Lord's protection. Signified, Explained.

For they know that the Lord protects all who are in good against the evil; and that He protects them according to the good with them; but that He would not protect, if on account of the evil done them, they were to be kindled with enmity, hatred, and revenge; for these avert the protection.
Not to resist evil = that we are not to fight back, nor retaliate: the Angels... permit evil to be done to them, because they are safe by the Lord...
The protection of the faithful by the Lord. Signified.
Their protection by Divine truth. Signified.

When an evil Spirit attacks... (anyone) whom the Lord protects, he at once deprives himself of protection by the Lord; for every Spirit both evil and good is in the Lord's protection; and, when he is deprived of it, he falls into evils and falsities of every kind which are from Hell, and at the same time into the hands of those who are thence, and are called punishers. AE 643:2.
Separation and consequent protection. Signified. (Compare AE 670.)
Protection from falsities and evils which are from Hell. Signified. (That is) protection through Divine truth in ultimates...
This protection is signified by the cherubs.
To be comforted = to be protected.
The power of the Lord to protect His own in the Church through His Divine truth... Signified.
From love truly conjugial there are power and protection against the Hells. Explained.
That they are not without protection. Signified.
For good and its affection does not defend itself; but it is defended by truth and its understanding.
